name: 约恩
src: 月银纪史诗/第十三歌_不空的水囊.md:194
who: Joen, a human helmsman of the old Pearl Strand harbour who has looked forty ever since he became a legend: about 181 cm, lean and sinewy, twenty years of sea turned into muscle on his arms and back. Untidy black curly hair tousled by the sea wind, salt crusted on the ends, not a grey hair at the temples. Sea-teal eyes like the sea before fog, always checking the sky before he looks at a person. A gaunt face with high cheekbones reddened by wind, an old scar through the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us), a short beard on the chin; deep laugh lines at the corners of his eyes. A battered fish-spear in one hand and a leather waterskin at his belt, its mouth cord tied in dozens of knots. A weathered, quiet, patient air, standing like the mast of a ship.
face: FACE, as in the references: a gaunt weathered man's face of about forty, high cheekbones reddened by wind, a scar through the left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when they face us), short beard, deep laugh lines at the eyes, sea-teal eyes; skin shadows a warm red-brown.
build: 181 cm, lean and sinewy: wiry arms and a strong back, narrow hips, a seaman's rolling stance.
palette: sea teal and oilcloth yellow, salt white, wet-rope brown, black curls
casual: A much-patched oilcloth coat with sleeve cuffs worn to threads, over a plain wool shirt and dark trousers; a leather waterskin hanging at his belt with its mouth cord tied in many knots; sandals of woven straw rope. He holds an old fish-spear upright in his right hand. He stands with weight on one leg like a man on a deck, a calm, narrow-eyed look.
private: A worn, soft, long-sleeved undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, loose dark trousers, the oilcloth coat folded over one arm, bare feet; the knotted waterskin still at his belt, the other hand empty and open at his side. A tired, mild look, a small smile at the eyes.
battle: Ready on a pitching deck: the oilcloth coat belted tight with a rope, leather bracers over the sleeves, trousers tied at the calves, the knotted waterskin at his belt. He holds the fish-spear low and level in both hands, point forward, knees bent and balanced. A hard, watchful look, mouth closed.
formal: His one clean outfit for a harbour ceremony: a dark blue wool outer coat lined with oilcloth, cut straight and belted with a plaited rope, a short sea-cloak pinned with a bronze fish-hook brooch, the knotted waterskin at his belt whose knots shimmer faintly like wet salt. The fish-spear stands upright at his side in one hand, its tip streaked with a thread of sea-light. He stands straight, a grave, uneasy look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the sea-teal eyes looking past the viewer at the sky, a faint weary half-turn of the head. Cold grey sea-light from one side with a low amber lamp glow behind. Foreground blur: sea spray, a coil of wet rope with knots, the iron tip of a fish-spear. He wears the patched oilcloth coat, salt in his curls.

name: 汀娜
src: 月银纪史诗/第十三歌_不空的水囊.md:250
who: Tina, a human net-mender of the old Pearl Strand harbour, nineteen: about 167 cm, slim, straight-shouldered, steady-handed. Black curly hair braided into one thick plait hanging down her back, a few curls escaping at the temples. Sea-teal eyes, thick straight brows, a clean thin face with a pointed chin and a mouth that is usually pressed shut. Fine rope-callus lines across her fingers. On a cord at her neck hangs a small brass thimble that was her mother's. A quiet, patient, steady air, like the lamp at a door.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young woman's clean thin face of about nineteen, thick straight dark brows, sea-teal eyes that look first at hands, a pointed chin, a small mouth pressed closed; skin shadows a soft pink-orange.
build: 167 cm, slender: straight shoulders and back, a small bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: harbour blue and sea teal, canvas cream, black curls, a little brass
casual: An old Pearl Strand harbour dress of faded blue cloth with long sleeves and a plain round neck, a canvas apron over it with pockets holding a netting shuttle and a small knife; her mother's brass thimble on a cord at her neck; cloth shoes. She stands upright with one hand on the apron pocket and a half-mended net folded over her other forearm, a calm, level look.
private: A soft undyed wool dress with long sleeves, a knitted grey shawl, thick stockings and house shoes, the black plait over one shoulder, the brass thimble at her neck; hands loosely folded in front. A quiet, gentle look.
battle: Ready for a rough crossing: the blue dress tucked and belted shorter over wool leggings, a leather jerkin over it, the canvas apron kept on, boots; the small knife held low in her right hand, the netting shuttle in the left; the plait pinned up. A tense, resolute look, mouth closed.
formal: For a harbour feast: a long dark teal wool dress with long sleeves and a neat collar, the plait coiled and pinned with a plain bone comb, a pale linen shawl, the brass thimble worn outside the dress. She stands very straight with hands folded in front, a serene, solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted slightly, the sea-teal eyes looking at the viewer first, lips closed. Warm lamp light from one side, cool dusk blue behind. Foreground blur: a hanging net with floats and a glass lantern flame. She wears the blue harbour dress and the canvas apron.

name: 哈康
src: 月银纪史诗/第十三歌_不空的水囊.md:307
who: Hakon, a human ship captain from the northern fjords, forty-six: about 192 cm, huge, broad-shouldered and thick-armed, strong enough to push a grounded boat alone. Short cropped flame-red hair, a red beard braided into two short plaits in the northern fashion. Pale ice-blue eyes, a big face reddened by sea wind, a loud easy grin. The little finger of his left hand is missing (the left hand is on the viewer's right when they face us). A small bronze bell hangs at his belt with its clapper wrapped in leather. A boisterous, warm, big-voiced air. IMPORTANT: his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has only four digits, thumb, index, middle and ring finger; where the little finger should be there is only a short healed stump at the edge of the palm. Draw this four-fingered hand clearly in every panel where that hand shows, including the open spread hand in the battle panel; his right hand is a normal five-fingered hand.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, weathered, wind-reddened man's face of about forty-six, red cropped hair, red beard in two short plaits, ice-blue eyes with crow's feet, a wide grin; skin shadows a warm red-orange.
build: 192 cm, huge and barrel-chested: thick shoulders and arms, a broad belly, strong legs.
palette: flame red and ice blue, thick wool grey, oilcloth yellow-brown, a little bronze
casual: A thick northern-cut wool coat in dark grey with a high collar, an oilcloth cape thrown over it, wide belt, heavy sea boots; a small bronze bell at his belt, its clapper wrapped in leather so it does not ring; a short wood-axe held in his right hand with the head resting against his shoulder. He stands with his feet wide, a big confident grin.
private: A loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a sleeveless sheepskin vest, wide trousers, soft boots, the bronze bell still on his belt; arms folded over his chest. A relaxed laughing look.
battle: Ready to cut cable: the wool coat belted tight, the oilcloth cape thrown back over one shoulder, leather bracers, the leather-wrapped bronze bell at his belt. He holds the short axe low in his right hand and the left hand open and ready, feet planted wide. A fierce, shouting look.
formal: His best northern coat: a thick, straight-cut dark-blue wool outer coat belted with a wide black leather belt, a heavy oilcloth cape over the shoulders pinned at the throat with a bronze pin worked with a small rune knot that hums faintly in the wind, heavy sea boots. The leather-wrapped bronze bell hangs at his belt. He stands very upright, chin raised, a proud, solemn grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the ice-blue eyes laughing, the red beard plaits swinging. Cold white sea light from one side, grey fog behind. Foreground blur: fog drifting past, the blurred bronze bell and a rope. He wears the dark wool coat with the oilcloth cape.

name: 苏琪
src: 月银纪史诗/第十三歌_不空的水囊.md:363
who: Suki, a fox-eared fisher girl of the Pearl Strand, eighteen: about 156 cm, small, quick and nimble. Messy short orange-red hair, a pair of pointed fox ears on top of her head with white tips (she has no other human ears), a big fluffy tail with a white tip behind her. Gold eyes with up-tilted corners, narrowed as if sniffing the wind, a small face with a pointed chin, one small fox tooth showing when she grins. On a cord at her neck hangs her late father's small bone whistle. A cheeky, restless, sharp-nosed air; she hates her tail getting wet.
face: FACE, as in the references: a small cheeky face of about eighteen, up-tilted gold eyes narrowed, pointed chin, one small tooth showing in a grin, fox ears with white tips on top of the head and NO human ears at the sides; skin shadows a soft pink-orange.
build: 156 cm, small and slim, light and agile.
palette: orange-red and white, sea gold, faded fisher blue-grey, bone
casual: Fisher-folk clothes: a short tunic of faded blue-grey cloth with the sleeves rolled up and trouser legs rolled to the calf, a coil of fishing line and a bone fish-hook at her belt, her father's bone whistle on its cord, bare feet; the white-tipped tail free behind her. She stands leaning slightly forward with one hand to her nose, a sniffing grin.
private: A loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt to mid-thigh over short soft trousers, a knitted wool scarf, bare feet, the bone whistle at her neck; she stands with her arms wrapped round her own tail held in front of her. A sleepy, content grin.
battle: Ready to climb and cut: the fisher tunic tied tight with a leather belt, leather wrist guards, the fishing line wound round her forearm; a sharp bone hook gripped low in her right hand, the left hand reaching forward, knees bent, the tail stiff behind her. A fierce, fast look, the ears flat.
formal: For a harbour feast: a clean sea-blue wool dress with short sleeves over a white blouse, a red ribbon tying the tail's base, a tidy hem, her father's whistle worn outside, shoes on her feet for once. She stands very straight and uncomfortable, a self-conscious closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the fox ears pricked, the gold eyes narrowed and looking at the viewer. Warm low sunset light from one side, sea spray glitter behind. Foreground blur: wet rope, a drifting fishing float and spray. She wears the fisher tunic.
